d:
A man in Dubai has grabbed the internet’s attention by bringing 53 old iPhones to an Apple Store while picking up two of Apple’s latest foldable smartphones, the iPhone Duo!
Meet Mohammed Shakaa, a die-hard Apple fan who has been collecting iPhones for nearly two decades. His collection reportedly spans from the original iPhone to the iPhone 18 Pro Max, with multiple colour variants of some models.
But why would anyone collect 53 iPhones? And what made this Apple superfan bring his entire collection to the store?
